name: Praha
note: 2 km around Staroměstské náměstí. Starts are the river and New Town driving loop; the castle and Charles Bridge stay places you see, not spawn points. Bridges, tunnels, the Vltava channel and Czech fleet live on this circle; longer roads stay later corridors.

liveries.note: DPP city fleet: red body with a cream band, estimated from the public Škoda 15T tram and red-and-cream city bus. Not an official colour specification.

buildings3d.note: Photogrammetric LOD2 roofs and walls. IPR also publishes this model as CityGML; the public scene layer is the copy this build downloads for the playable circle.
